author: bridge-bot
content: <gakonst> QQ: If a client wants to submit a blob transaction, they need to compute the commitment + aggregate proof for all blob elements right? So they need to have the KZG params stored locally. How many powers of Tau do we think we’ll need to produce kzg proofs?

author: kevaundray
content:
Proto posted a link: <https://hackmd.io/@protolambda/eip4844-meta>  it states that `Blobs are 4096 field-elements` so 2^12 G1 elements would definitely be needed.

I'm not familiar with 4844 specs/implementations so I can't answer your question with certainty
